name: ibkr-zectrix-dashboard
description: Configure and run a secret-safe, read-only IBKR portfolio dashboard for ZECTRIX NOTE4.

interface.shortDescription: Refresh a read-only IBKR dashboard on NOTE4.
interface.longDescription: Renders a 400x300 monochrome portfolio dashboard, remembers only non-secret preferences, and reads credentials from the user's Keychain or runtime secret environment.
defaultPrompt: Configure my IBKR NOTE4 dashboard without exposing secrets.
Preview my IBKR portfolio dashboard before pushing it.
Refresh my NOTE4 using my remembered safe settings.
